capabilities: Fetch the first Wikipedia section for the active note's title
Fetch the first Wikipedia section for a search term
Format pasted extracts with templates and variables
Choose the Wikipedia language edition via a prefix setting
extras: Requires internet access to reach wikipedia.org; the README lists settings in detail but gives no usage examples or screenshots.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull a quick reference extract from Wikipedia into a note, requiring manual lookup, copy and paste.
summary: Inserts the first section of a Wikipedia article into the active note, using the note title or a typed search term.
